jobs.title: Software Dev Engineer
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Customer Service (CS) is hiring a Software Development Engineer II to join the Associate Experience team. Our organization is at the forefront of customer experience — seeking to delight our customers in every interaction they have, whether through self-serve technology and tools (e.g., chatbots), or by interacting directly with our Customer Service Associates (CSA).  
  
Customer Service works to offer effective, empathetic, and efficient issue resolution when our customers need us, and we are also champions of driving defects out of customer experiences across the entire company, relentlessly advocating on behalf of customers and keeping them at the heart of everything we do.  
  
As a Software Development Engineer II on this team, you will design, develop, and own comprehensive customer engagement services and solutions that anticipate and resolve customer questions at global scale. You will partner with cross-functional teams to drive technical strategy and improvements to our technology platform, owning systems that power the ultimate customer service experience. You will also contribute to engineering best practices and mentor junior engineers on the team. You should be somebody who thrives on solving difficult technical problems, designing scalable solutions, and feels strongly about building reliable software with a customer-centric mindset.  
  
We use Scrum, test-driven development, and continuous deployment to deliver projects by making effective trade-offs between time, quality, and resources. If you are results-oriented, data-driven, and passionate about creating innovative customer experiences through technology, we would love to connect with you.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Design, develop, and own software services and tools that solve difficult business and operational problems, delivering with a focus on simplicity and scalability  
Optimize and enhance existing systems for performance, reliability, and maintainability at Amazon scale  
Make informed technical decisions on system design, technology selection, and problem-solving approaches with limited guidance  
Identify and mitigate technical risks early in the development lifecycle, escalating when appropriate  
Partner with engineers and cross-functional teams to contribute to design reviews, align on technical direction, and drive improvements across team boundaries  
Make effective trade-offs between time, quality, and resources to deliver high-quality results within project timelines  
Track, analyze, and act on key metrics to optimize system performance and drive continuous improvement  
Identify and implement engineering process improvements, contributing to operational excellence and best practices across the team  
Mentor junior engineers by providing technical guidance, conducting code reviews, and fostering a culture of learning and high standards  
Write clear technical documentation, including design documents and operational runbooks, to support system ownership and team knowledge sharing  
  
A day in the life  
As a Software Development Engineer II on the Associate Experience team, no two days look exactly the same — but each one centers on building technology that makes a real difference for Customer Service Associates (CSAs) and the customers they serve. You might start your morning reviewing metrics from a recent deployment, analyzing how a feature you own is performing at scale and identifying areas for optimization. Then you could be deep in a design review with your team, debating trade-offs between approaches for a new generative AI-powered automation feature. After that, you shift to hands-on coding — writing, testing, and shipping production-quality code using test-driven development and continuous deployment practices. Throughout the day, you collaborate with product managers and other SDEs to shape technical direction and translate customer needs into scalable solutions. You also make time to review pull requests from teammates and mentor junior engineers on best practices. Some days involve investigating and resolving production issues, making quick decisions to mitigate risks and keep systems running reliably. By end of day, you have contributed meaningfully to services that touch millions of customer interactions worldwide.  
  
About the team  
The Associate Experience team develops products to support Amazon's Customer Service Associates (CSAs) in delivering seamless customer service. Our mission is to empower CSAs with intelligent solutions — powered by generative AI, machine learning, and automation — that anticipate customer needs and accelerate issue resolution at global scale. We build AI assistants, contact automation, and real-time insight tools that reduce CSA effort and improve the customer experience with every interaction. Our team values innovation, ownership, and collaboration, and you will have the opportunity to work alongside talented engineers who are passionate about using cutting-edge technology to make a meaningful impact on how millions of customers experience Amazon support.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager-Technical, Amazon Business
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Come be a part of a rapidly expanding $60 billion dollar global business. At Amazon Business, a fast-growing startup passionate about building solutions, we set out every day to innovate and disrupt the status quo. We stand at the intersection of tech & retail in the B2B space developing innovative purchasing and procurement solutions to help businesses and organizations thrive. At Amazon Business, we strive to be the most recognized and preferred strategic partner for smart business buying. Bring your insight, imagination and a healthy disregard for the impossible. Join us in building and celebrating the value of Amazon Business to buyers and sellers of all sizes and industries. Unlock your career potential.  
  
Our team owns the product and technology for many exciting and complicated products like e-procurement system integrations, Punchout, Electronic Invoicing, Business APIs and many more. Within this space, we are looking for a product owner with proven experiences in thought leadership, product management, and detailed execution to define, lead, and develop a suite of integration focused products to provide an unrivaled customer experience for businesses using Amazon.com. These businesses range from small businesses to large enterprises.  
  
From Day 1, PMTs are given ownership of large products, the autonomy to think strategically and make data-driven decisions and the ability to drive significant impact to the customer experience and the business. Over their careers, PMTs will be exposed to multiple businesses and products, and pushed to grow into senior level managers who independently run large business segments and organizations. If you’re entrepreneurial, and want to innovate, build, and own transformative products and features, join us in making history.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Specifically, this PMT will:  
1. Define a multi-year vision and strategy to meet system integration needs of businesses of all shapes and sizes.  
2. Manage key aspects of integration experience – ranging from punch-out, electronic ordering, eInvoicing, and liaison with operations and technology teams to drive improvements.  
3. Own business requirements, participate in sprint planning meetings and deliver on the road map for process, and technology initiatives.  
4. Use business analytics and voice of the customer feedback to provide insight to all relevant product/project stakeholders to create and drive change to improve the customer experience.  
5. Identify opportunities to develop and drive solutions to scale through automation and self-service.  
6. Evangelize business integration vision among multiple Amazon teams and influence them to deliver business specific capabilities.  
7. Engage with our international teams to serve as thought-leader as we investigate opportunities to expand our offering world-wide.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
* Experience managing technical products or online services
* Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in using analytical tools, such as Tableau, Qlikview, QuickSight
* Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. jobs.description:
**Overview**

Search is how people find their work. Every day, people in organizations of every size rely on it to locate the document they edited last week, the email that captured a decision, the colleague who knows the answer, or the meeting where it was all discussed. When search works, it disappears into the flow of work; when it does not, it costs time, focus and confidence.

In Microsoft 365 Copilot, we are reimagining search with AI. Copilot Search understands what you mean, brings together email, files, chats, meetings and people, and composes a grounded answer with sources you can trust, right alongside the results you need to go deeper. We are looking for a **Software Engineer II** excited to build this experience at global scale.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities**  

* Design, build and ship Copilot Search features end to end in React and TypeScript, from design review and implementation through experimentation and worldwide rollout.
* Build performant, accessible and localized user interfaces that work consistently across web, desktop and mobile hosts, as well as SharePoint and OneDrive.
* Drive web performance through server-side rendering, hydration and rendering optimization, early data fetching, service workers and bundle-size reduction, with a focus on end-to-end latency and time to first answer.
* Integrate AI-generated answers into the search experience, including streaming responses, citations and source attribution, and graceful handling of partial or failed responses.
* Instrument features with telemetry, define success metrics, and run A/B experiments and staged rollouts to make data-driven product decisions.
* Own the reliability of the features you build, including monitoring, alerting, automated health checks and diagnosis of client issues such as authentication and host-loading failures.
* Participate in the team's on-call rotation, mitigating production incidents quickly and driving root-cause fixes so they do not recur.
* Partner closely with product managers, designers and backend search and relevance engineers to turn ambiguous ideas into polished, shippable experiences.
* Raise the engineering bar through thoughtful code reviews, automated testing and contributions to shared components and engineering practices.
* Use AI-assisted development tools and LLM-based techniques, such as automated analysis of user feedback and quality evaluation, to move faster and improve product quality.

  
**Qualifications**

**Required/Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 4+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python.
  + OR equivalent experience.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Solid experience building production web applications with React and TypeScript.
* Solid web fundamentals: HTML, CSS, browser rendering, web performance and server-side rendering.
* Experience building and operating large-scale web applications used by a broad customer base.
* Experience with telemetry, A/B experimentation and data-driven decision making.
* Working knowledge of accessibility standards and building inclusive user interfaces.
* Experience building LLM or AI-powered product features, such as streaming experiences.
* Exposure to mobile or cross-platform hosts, such as web experiences embedded in apps.
* Experience with live-site operations, monitoring and on-call responsibilities.
* Familiarity with search or information retrieval concepts is a plus.

jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Senior Manager / Deputy General Manager – Sales & Marketing (BESS)

**Job Title:** Senior Manager / Deputy General Manager (DGM) – Sales & Marketing  
**Industry:** Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), Renewable Energy & Power Systems  
**Experience:** 5–10 Years  
**Location:** Hyderabad, Telangana  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

About the Role

We are looking for a results-oriented Sales & Marketing professional to drive business growth in the Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) sector.

The role involves identifying market opportunities, developing customer relationships, managing bids and proposals, and achieving sales targets across utility, renewable energy, and commercial and industrial markets.

The ideal candidate should have experience in sales, business development, or marketing within BESS, renewable energy, power systems, power electronics, or related sectors.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop and execute sales and marketing strategies for BESS solutions.
* Identify business opportunities with utilities, independent power producers (IPPs), renewable energy developers, EPC contractors, and commercial and industrial (C&I) customers.
* Build and maintain relationships with customers, consultants, channel partners, and other key stakeholders.
* Manage the complete sales cycle, from lead generation and opportunity qualification through proposal submission, negotiation, and order closure.
* Track tenders and customer enquiries, and coordinate bid/no-bid assessments, tender submissions, and internal approvals.
* Collaborate with engineering, finance, legal, and execution teams to prepare technically suitable and commercially viable proposals.
* Understand customer requirements and coordinate solution development, including system sizing, application suitability, and project economics.
* Present BESS applications such as peak shaving, energy shifting, renewable energy integration, backup power, and grid support.
* Lead commercial negotiations covering pricing, payment terms, warranties, performance commitments, and contractual conditions.
* Monitor market developments, customer investment plans, competitor offerings, and relevant policy changes.
* Develop marketing presentations, product literature, customer proposals, and business cases.
* Represent the company at customer meetings, exhibitions, conferences, and industry events.
* Maintain accurate sales forecasts, opportunity pipelines, and management reports.
* Coordinate customer handover to project execution teams and support payment collection and ongoing account development.

Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Energy Engineering, or a related discipline.
* An MBA in Marketing or Business Management is preferred.
* 5–10 years of experience in sales, business development, or marketing in BESS, renewable energy, power systems, power electronics, or related sectors.
* Direct experience selling BESS or energy storage solutions is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to develop business, manage complex bids, negotiate contracts, and achieve sales targets.
* Experience working with utilities, renewable energy developers, EPC contractors, or commercial and industrial customers.

Technical & Commercial Knowledge

* Working knowledge of BESS architecture, including batteries, Battery Management Systems (BMS), Power Conversion Systems (PCS), and Energy Management Systems (EMS).
* Understanding of key technical parameters such as power and energy ratings, storage duration, efficiency, cycle life, degradation, and warranties.
* Ability to assess customer requirements and explain the technical and financial benefits of proposed solutions.
* Familiarity with tendering processes, commercial contracts, project costing, and financial concepts such as payback period, Return on Investment (ROI), and Total Cost of Ownership (TCO).

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate will be a commercially driven professional with experience in energy storage or related power and renewable energy sectors. They should be capable of identifying new business opportunities, managing complex sales cycles, coordinating technical and commercial proposals, and building strong customer relationships to achieve business growth.

Job Location

Hyderabad, Telangana.

Employment Type

Full-Time.

Work Location: In person

Join Opella’s Integration Platform team as Release Manager and take full accountability for release management across the global integration landscape. Job Description
  
  
About Digital Human Health (DHH)
  
Digital Human Health (DHH) connects technology, data, and people to enable and accelerate Human Health business across global markets. DHH supports commercial and medical teams by delivering customer-centric digital platforms, data capabilities, and technology-enabled operating models that enable flexible go-to-market approaches, actionable insights, and personalized customer experiences in a regulated environment.
  
Within DHH, the Content Creation Storage pillar of Digital Content Customer Experience (DCCE) builds the platforms and capabilities that help Human Health create compliant, on-brand content faster. As part of the Content Accelerator, the pillar is moving content creation from manual production to AI-generated content that is built to brand and compliance standards from the start, combining agentic content creation platform (Content Studio), Adobe capabilities, and the design system.
  
Role Purpose
  
Own business analysis for Content Studio, AI-enabled content creation capability. Turn business needs into clear, build-ready, and traceable requirements, and work hands-on alongside engineering, UX, and implementation partners from discovery through release.
  
The role is the Product Owner’s day-to-day partner. As the person grows, they will be expected to take on product ownership for defined Content Studio features or components, including backlog decisions, stakeholder alignment, and release outcomes.
  
Scope of Ownership Adjacent Responsibilities
  
  
**Accountable for (owns the deliverable and its quality):**

* Manage requirement changes and log scope decisions so everyone knows what changed and why.

* Build a working understanding of the platform’s architecture, integrations, and APIs to have informed discussions with engineering and partners.
* Coordinate UAT with business users, capturing feedback, defects, and gaps and following them through to resolution.

Documentation, Governance Communication

Stakeholder Vendor Collaboration
  
  

* Facilitate requirement workshops and working sessions that end in clear decisions and owners.
* Review vendor and partner solutions against documented requirements, and raise gaps early.
* Act as the bridge between business and technical teams so both share the same understanding of what is being built and why.

What Success Looks Like
  
  

* Stories reach sprint planning ready to build, with little rework or mid-sprint clarification.
* Content Studio has one current, trusted source of truth that engineers, partners, and new joiners actually use.
* Every released feature can be traced back to a business need and an agreed acceptance test.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, Compute Platform
jobs.description:
Dive in and do the best work of your career at DigitalOcean. Journey alongside a strong community of top talent who are relentless in their drive to build the simplest scalable cloud. If you have a growth mindset, naturally like to think big and bold, and are energized by the fast-paced environment of a true industry disruptor, you’ll find your place here. We value winning together—while learning, having fun, and making a profound difference for the dreamers and builders in the world.
  
  
**Position Overview**
We are looking for a
**Staff Product Manager, Compute Platform**
who is passionate about running managed compute services at scale, namely App Platform, Serverless Functions, and Container Registry, and who understands that a great platform experience is built on well-run infrastructure underneath it.
  
  
As a Staff Product Manager, Compute Platform at DigitalOcean, you will join a dynamic team dedicated to revolutionizing cloud computing. You will own the product strategy and roadmap for App Platform, Serverless Functions, and Container Registry (DOCR), the managed compute services that turn DO's Droplet fleet into a place where developers can ship without thinking about servers. That means owning both sides of each service, the developer-facing product and the platform economics beneath it, such as how workloads are packed onto compute, what each app, function, or image pull costs to serve, and how processor, virtualization, and container runtime trends shape our roadmap. You will report to the Director of Product and partner day to day with the Hyderabad-based Compute Cloud Services engineering team that builds the business logic, APIs, and control plane for DO Compute, as well as with our Droplet/VPC, Kubernetes, and infrastructure product peers, finance, and GTM. The ideal person becomes the PM who can hold a customer conversation about deploy workflows in the morning and a capacity and margin conversation in the afternoon, the partner engineering trusts on architecture tradeoffs, and a core part of building out the compute platform PM group in India.
  
  
What you'll do
  
  

* Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for App Platform, Serverless Functions, and DOCR, aligned with DO's overall compute platform strategy, and translate them into prioritized, well-scoped features that are simple to use and efficient to run.
* Own the platform economics of these services. Define how apps, functions, and registry storage map onto Droplets and shared compute, track cost to serve per unit of customer workload, and drive utilization, density, and bin-packing improvements with engineering and finance.
* Stay ahead of the compute landscape that underpins the platform, including processor roadmaps from Intel, AMD, and ARM, virtualization and microVM technologies, and container runtimes and isolation models, and translate those trends into platform decisions such as instance sizing, runtime choices, and price/performance tiers.
* Define the end-to-end developer journey across these services, from source repo or container image to a deployed, autoscaled, observable app or function, and remove the seams (auth, networking, registry, logs, billing) that make customers stitch it together themselves today.
* Work backwards from customers. Run discovery with developers, startups, and SMB platform teams, mine support and community signal, and turn it into clear jobs-to-be-done, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Own packaging and pricing for platform services, including how compute, egress, build minutes, storage, invocations, and image pulls are metered, how pricing tracks cost to serve, and how the services attach to Droplets, GPUs, managed databases, DOKS, and Spaces.
* Partner with engineering on architecture tradeoffs in the control plane and data plane, such as build pipelines, autoscaling and scheduling behavior, cold start and concurrency for Serverless Functions, registry performance and garbage collection, and multi-region placement.
* Drive performance, reliability, and efficiency outcomes with clear SLOs and cost targets, and champion the fixes that move them.
* Monitor the competitive landscape for managed compute and PaaS offerings, and identify where DO can differentiate on simplicity, price/performance, or both.
* Lead launches end to end with product marketing, docs, sales, and support, and own the results after GA, including adoption, activation, retention, and margin.

Key metrics
  
  

* Platform services revenue and attach rate (share of Droplet, GPU, database, and DOKS customers also running App Platform or Serverless Functions, and share pulling from DOCR).
* Infrastructure efficiency, measured as fleet utilization and density for the compute serving these services, and cost per unit of customer workload (per app instance, per invocation, per GB stored and pulled).
* Gross margin per service, and the gap between pricing and cost to serve as the fleet and processor mix evolve.
* Activation, retention, and expansion, measured as time to first deploy and as apps, functions, and registries active at 30/90/180 days.
* Reliability and performance against SLO, e.g. deploy and build success rate, control plane availability, Serverless Functions cold start p95, image pull latency.

What you'll add to DigitalOcean
  
  

* 8+ years of product management experience, with a proven track record defining and launching managed cloud compute, PaaS, serverless, or container products, ideally where you owned both the customer experience and the unit economics.
* Strong working knowledge of PaaS, serverless, and container registry models, including buildpack-based deploys, function runtimes and triggers, concurrency and cold start tradeoffs, and OCI image build, storage, and distribution.
* Compute fluency. A solid understanding of the cloud compute landscape, including CPU architectures (Intel, AMD, ARM) and their price/performance characteristics, virtualization and microVMs, cont…

jobs.description:
Job Description:

**Job Purpose**

At Intercontinental Exchange (ICE), we engineer technology, exchanges and clearing houses that connect companies around the world to global capital and derivative markets. With a leading-edge approach to developing technology platforms, we have built market infrastructure in all major trading centers, offering customers the ability to manage risk and make informed decisions globally. By leveraging our core strengths in technology, we continue to identify new ways to serve our customers and transform global markets.

AIP Suites (Data Modernization to Snowflake) builds an analytics-ready data architecture where data from source systems such as PDM (Product Data Management) and RDO is ingested into Snowflake for centralized storage and modeling. These models support ICE BI, which consumes Snowflake data for analytics and dashboarding. This design ensures clean separation between raw ingestion, transformation, analytics, and service-based consumption, supporting scalable and future-proof data-driven operations.

ICE Mortgage Technology is seeking a Data Engineer who will be responsible for design and optimize SQL queries, develop stored procedures, and participate in the migration and modernization of legacy applications to support IMT (ICE Mortgage Technology) Products. The candidate should have a strong background in SQL and Stored Procedures

**Responsibilities**

* Provides Snowflake-based data warehouse design and development for projects involving new data integration, migration, and enhancement of existing pipelines.
* Designs and develops data transformation logic using SQL, Snowflake stored procedures, and Python-based scripts for ETL/ELT workloads.
* Builds and maintains robust data pipelines to support reporting, analytics, and application data needs.
* Creates and maintains Snowflake objects like tables, views, streams, tasks, file formats, and external stages.
* Participates in project meetings with data engineers, analysts, business users, and product owners to understand and implement technical requirements.
* Writes technical design documentation based on business requirements and data architecture principles.
* Develops and/or reviews unit testing protocols for SQL scripts, procedures, and data pipelines using automation frameworks.
* Completes documentation and procedures for pipeline deployment, operational handover, and monitoring.
* May mentor or guide junior developers and data engineers.
* Stays current with Snowflake features, best practices, and industry trends in cloud data platforms.
* Performs additional related duties as assigned.

**Knowledge and Experience**

* Bachelor’s Degree or the equivalent combination of education, training, or work experience.
* 5+ years of professional experience in data engineering or database development.
* Strong Hands-on experience:
* Writing complex SQL queries and stored procedures
* Database stored procedures, functions, views, and schema design
* Using Streams, Tasks, Time Travel, and Cloning
* Proficiency in database performance tuning and performance optimization — clustering, warehouse sizing, caching, etc.
* Experience configuring external stages to integrate with cloud storage (AWS S3, Azure Blob, etc.).
* Experience writing Python/Shell scripts for data processing (where needed).
* Knowledge on Snowflake and Tidal is an added advantage
* Proficiency in using Git and working within Agile/Scrum SDLC environments.
* Familiarity working in a Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) leveraging Agile principles.
* Excellent analytical, decision-making, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment with a focus on timeliness, documentation, and communication with peers and business users.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills to engage both technical and non-technical audiences at various organizational levels.

In this position, you will guide cross-functional software development teams delivering complex projects built on modern **Java/Spring and/or .NET/C# stacks**. You will oversee projects where **ChatGPT (OpenAI), Claude (Anthropic), Copilot, or other AI tools** are utilized. APIs are being embedded into our Java or .NET backends to create intelligent user experiences (such as chat assistants, intelligent document analysis, or automated workflows).

The perfect candidate has a solid technical foundation (preferably a background in software engineering or systems architecture) and holds the strategic mindset needed to navigate complex stakeholder landscapes, oversee multi-million dollar budgets, and advocate for modern Agile methodologies.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Orchestrate end-to-end software delivery for complex, enterprise-level Java/.NET applications using Agile (Scrum or Kanban) methodologies
* Adapt traditional Agile metrics (team velocity, sprint burn-down, cycle time) to analyze and optimize productivity gains achieved through GenAI tools
* Coordinate sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog grooming, and retrospectives, ensuring development workflows seamlessly integrate AI code generation, automated unit testing, and code review
* Manage project scopes, timelines, resource allocation, and multi-million dollar budgets
* Act as a highly technical liaison between developers, architects, product owners, and business leaders
* Guide the team through complex project milestones involving Java/Spring Boot and/or .NET Core/C# ecosystems, microservices architectures, RESTful APIs, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP)

* Identify, track, and proactively mitigate risks, technical dependencies, and blockers before they impact delivery timelines
* Collaborate with Product Management to align the technical roadmap with business priorities and product backlogs

**Requirements**

* Expertise in Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) and scaled agile frameworks (SAFe)
* Advanced proficiency in project management and collaboration tools, specifically Jira, Confluence, and MS Project

* Skills in strong negotiation and conflict resolution
* Capability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-change environment

jobs.title: Business Analyst, Network Strategy & Performance, Network Strategy and Preformance
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Business Analyst in Network Strategy and Performance owns processes & analytics that directly shape how Amazon serves customers globally. They are an analytical problem solver who is comfortable in a fast-paced, multi-tasked, high-energy environment. They are self-motivated, operating independently in an autonomous environment to deliver an exceptional customer experience with little to no guidance. They operationalize the long- and short-term staffing plans, working cross-functionally with site Operations, planning teams, training, finance, and others. They will contribute to the team's AI-driven transformation agenda by applying AI tools to increase the speed, quality, and scale of analytical outputs. They do not just report or fix defects, but think critically about why they happen, what surrounds them, and how to prevent them — combining analytical rigor with a proactive, anticipatory mindset.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Create and accurately maintain CSA shift schedules ensuring shifts are optimally planned to meet the sites short term forecast requirements and Service Levels (SL).
* Monitor actual staffing levels against planned staffing and take the relevant corrective actions as required improve SL.
* Effectively plan and monitor CSA adherence to assigned schedule, including productive and non-productive activities.
* Work closely with mid to senior-level leaders across core teams to identify and mitigate emerging risks and assists in creating mitigation plans for staffing corrections and SL recovery.
* Responsible for coordinating site-staffing needs including reporting and analysis of site headcount numbers as per staffing plan.
* Understanding and monitor symptoms of CSA burnout, detecting the metrics that can signal these symptoms and assist in implementing interventions to eliminate outlier experiences.
* Responsible to coordinate various cross-training, new-hires, and management of network and site-wide shift rotation processes as per business need.
* Create work schedules for associates, identifies and proactively resolves headcount deficiencies and overages.
* Investigate defects and operational anomalies to identify systemic drivers (system-related, behavioral, or shared responsibility), not just symptoms. Highlight and communicate metrics impacting the operation that could impact service levels, customer experience, and business process.
* Build and maintain validation checks, dashboards, and automated alerts to catch defects early — before they impact customers or operations.
* Independently apply AI tools (e.g., Amazon Q, generative AI assistants, AgentZ) to accelerate analytical workflows, identifying opportunities to improve speed and quality of outputs.
* Apply AI tools to develop automation for repetitive tasks within your workstream, demonstrating measurable productivity improvement.

  
About the team  
The Network Strategy and Performance (NP) team defines and delivers the right human-assisted support to Amazon customers under demand and labor supply volatility, by optimizing the Amazon Customer Service (CS) network for customer experience, associate experience, and cost. We are responsible for: (1) planning customer support staffing; (2) preserving the customer experience when customers contact Customer Service; and (3) ensuring best costs for providing customer support.  
We analyse historical data and anticipate potential business events to accurately predict the number of Customer Service Associates (CSAs) required for a given period. Our areas of expertise span forecasting, planning, optimization, data analytics, and reporting. We deliver our vision using operations research, data science, and program management — and we continue to challenge the status quo, invent and simplify, and deliver excellence for our customers.  
The Network Performance team is on a transformation journey. We are building a future-ready team that combines analytical rigor with AI fluency, executive-level communication, and the ability to drive outcomes across organizational boundaries. We are seeking a Business Analyst to join this team and help shape how Amazon plans, staff, and optimizes its Customer Service network.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 2+ years of program or project management experience
* 1+ years of supply chain experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in a quantitative field (engineering, economics, math, and statistics), business or equivalent
* 4+ years of supply chain experience, or a MBA and 4+ years of managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* Experience using AI-assisted development tools in academic or professional settings

jobs.description:
### **Description**

The Quality Assurance Analyst will perform quality assurance activities for a large, web-based, cloud-hosted application used to create and support cloud-provisioned systems.

The role will involve both manual and automated testing, with the initial focus primarily on manual testing. As the team continues to increase its test automation efforts, the role is expected to gradually involve more automation testing.

The ideal candidate should have strong QA fundamentals, attention to detail, analytical and problem-solving skills, and the ability to understand an application from an end-user perspective. Experience or knowledge of automation, programming, SQL Server, web applications, and cloud technologies will be valuable for this position.

### **A Typical Day in the Life Includes:**

  

* Perform manual and automated testing based on product and business requirements.
* Design, create, and execute test plans and test cases.
* Execute manual and automated regression testing.
* Identify, analyze, and report software defects and product issues.
* Communicate test findings clearly to the development team.
* Track identified defects through resolution and verify fixes.
* Monitor progress on product issues and ensure appropriate follow-up.
* Create and maintain wiki pages and documentation for features being tested.
* Ensure the final product meets defined requirements and end-user expectations.
* Work closely with the development and QA teams to improve overall product quality.
* Contribute to the team's growing test automation efforts.

  

### **Basic Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or relevant professional experience in Software Development, Software QA, Software Customer Support, Business Analysis, or a closely related area.
* Preferably 3+ years of experience in Software Quality Assurance, Software Development, or a related field. Candidates with less experience may also be considered if they demonstrate strong development skills.
* Strong understanding of manual testing and Software Quality Assurance principles.
* Experience with or knowledge of test automation and programming concepts.
* Exposure to automation technologies such as Playwright, TypeScript, and Kiro would be beneficial.
* Experience creating test plans and executing regression test suites.
* Knowledge of SQL Server and the ability to construct SQL queries.
* Experience with web application testing or development.
* Knowledge of at least one programming or scripting language.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively as part of a team and handle complex tasks with minimal supervision.

* Experience in a SaaS environment.
* Experience with REST API testing or development.
* Knowledge of Selenium.

* Exposure to AWS technologies such as S3, EC2, EBS, Step Functions, and Lambda.
* Experience with cloud provisioning, cloud automation, or virtual machines.
* Experience with logging solutions such as Sumo Logic, Splunk, or Logstash.
* Understanding of defect-tracking systems and change-control procedures.
* Experience with Kiro, Claude, or similar AI tools used for software test automation.

**Corporate Engineering, AI and DataEngineering**

### **Role Overview**

Reporting to the **Senior Manager, Corporate Data Cloud** , you will lead DevOps, platform automation, and operational reliability across our Data Platform services. This role succeeds when teams can release changes safely, recover quickly from issues, meet cloud engineering standards, and spend more time delivering value than managing infrastructure.

  
  

**What You will Do**
--------------------

### **Build and Improve Platform Engineering**

We are investing in modern engineering practices that make our platforms easier to build, operate, and support.

You will:

* Define and promote DevOps, DevSecOps, and Platform Engineering practices across the Data Platform capability.

process, not added afterwards.

* Improve monitoring, observability, alerting, operational visibility, and service health across platform services.
* Ensure AWS services and platform components align with standards and controls defined by Central Cloud Engineering and Cyber Security teams.
* Identify, prioritise, and coordinate remediation of vulnerabilities, cloud configuration findings, compliance gaps, and operational risks.
* Lead incident response, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement activities that strengthen platform resilience.
* Maintain operational documentation, controls, and evidence required for audit and compliance reviews.

jobs.description:
**About KrisAtWork**

Kris@Work is the new generation AI-native Go-To-Market platform. It runs a B2B company's entire revenue engine, from finding the right accounts to closing and growing them. Revenue teams today juggle 25+ disconnected tools. Kris@Work replaces them with a single system, powered by its proprietary Kris Tell Intelligence™ layer and a multi-agent architecture that thinks, decides, and acts across the revenue cycle.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a AI-native Product Manager who blends product thinking, data science rigor, and comes with hands-on AI fluency. This role owns the end-to-end product lifecycle for AI-driven capabilities, ranging from predictive models to generative experiences, translating complex data & ML systems into scalable, customer-impacting products.

The ideal candidate has prior experience in data science or ML, deeply understands model behavior, trade-offs, and evaluation, and can partner seamlessly with engineering, ML, and business stakeholders to ship intelligent, impactful, reliable & explainable AI products.

**What You’ll Do**

**Product Strategy & AI Vision**

* Define & own the AI product vision and roadmap, aligned with business outcomes and measurable customer value
* Identify high-leverage prediction and generation opportunities across user workflows
* Translate ambiguous business problems into clear AI-powered product hypotheses
* Prioritize features using data, expected lift, confidence intervals & ROI modeling

**Predictive AI Ownership**

* Lead products powered by classification, regression, ranking, forecasting & anomaly detection models
* Define prediction targets, labels, features, and success criteria in collaboration with AI/ ML engineering teams
* Drive decisions around model refresh cadence, retraining triggers & drift detection

**Generative AI & LLM-Driven Experiences**

* Own GenAI use-cases including summarization, recommendations, copilots, content generation & reasoning workflows
* Design prompt strategies, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool-calling & memory architectures
* Balance determinism, creativity, latency & cost across GenAI experiences
* Define evaluation frameworks for GenAI quality (faithfulness, relevance, completeness, toxicity, hallucinations)

**Data-Driven Product Execution**

* Write clear, technical PRDs that include data inputs & outputs, model assumptions & constraints, evaluation metrics & guardrails, failure modes & fallback strategies
* Partner deeply with ML engineers to review feature pipelines, model choices & offline vs online evaluation results
* Make informed trade-offs between rules, heuristics, classical ML & LLMs

**Experimentation & Measurement**

* Design and own A/B tests, holdouts & phased rollouts for AI features
* Measure incremental impact, not just accuracy (conversion lift, time saved, win-rate, retention)
* Build feedback loops to improve models using human-in-the-loop signals
* Define north-star & secondary metrics for AI success

**Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Act as the product glue between ML, engineering, design, sales, customer success & leadership
* Translate technical AI concepts into clear business narratives for executives
* Partner with go-to-market teams on AI positioning, trust messaging & explainability
* Influence without authority, and set direction through clarity & data

**AI Ethics, Trust & Reliability**

* Ensure responsible AI practices around bias detection & mitigation, explainability & transparency as well as privacy, data governance & compliance
* Define guardrails, confidence indicators, and override mechanisms for AI outputs
* Proactively identify edge cases and failure scenarios before customers do

**Who You Are & What Makes You Qualified**

* 4+ years of Product Management experience, with significant ownership of data and/or AI-powered products
* Proven track record shipping predictive models and/or GenAI products to production
* Strong understanding of supervised & unsupervised ML, feature engineering & data pipelines, model evaluation & experimentation
* Practical experience with LLMs (OpenAI/ Anthropic), RAG, embeddings, vector databases, prompt engineering & evaluation
* Comfortable querying data (SQL) & reading Python notebooks
* Ability to reason about model performance, trade-offs & limitations
* Deep intuition for user workflows & decision-making under uncertainty
* Ability to connect model output to user action & business outcome
* Strong prioritization skills grounded in data, not intuition alone
* Experience building 0→1 AI products or scaling AI features across large user bases
* Experience with B2B SaaS, sales tech, CRM, or revenue intelligence platforms is preferred
* Prior hands-on experience as a Data Scientist, ML Engineer, or Applied Scientist is preferred
* Exposure to real-time systems, streaming data, or low-latency inference
* Experience working with enterprise customers and regulated data
* Familiarity with AI infra tools (feature stores, model registries, monitoring)
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management & executive-level presentation & delivery skills
* Bachelor's degree in a technical, engineering, AI or related discipline; advanced degree is preferred

**At Precisely, we're not just building software — we're shaping the future of data integrity.**
As a global leader in data quality, data enrichment, and location intelligence, Precisely helps thousands of the world's most trusted brands make confident decisions with data they can rely on. We're an AI-first organization, which means artificial intelligence isn't a buzzword here — it's woven into how we build products, how we work, and how we think about solving complex problems for our customers. When you join Precisely, you join a team of curious, driven innovators who believe that better data makes the world run better. If you're ready to do meaningful work at the intersection of AI and data — and help define what's possible — we'd love for you to apply!
  
  
**Overview**
As a Product Manager (level to be determined by experience) for the Data Solutions business, you will own the technical direction of Data Solutions on Precisely’s AI Studio, and support contribute to the overall Data API, Cloud and SaaS strategy. You will set the roadmap and drive the engineering understanding of the backlog for Precisely’s hosted MCP Server, Skills, Agents and Apps. Additionally, you will assist with technical requirements, development resources and documentation for Precisely Data APIs. This is a hands-on, technical role at the intersection of Product Management and Engineering: you will become the subject matter expert on our technology, define acceptance criteria, consult on sprint priorities, resolve customer escalations, and make the daily calls that keep multiple engineering teams delivering results. You will partner closely with customers, support, QA, and the broader Product team to create Data Solutions for real-world addressing business challenges.

* Work closely with Sales Engineers to validate proposed solutions for field verified use cases

* Own and prioritize the backlog across multiple engineering teams, covering new features, enhancements to existing features. You will assist and advise the engineering team on their defects and technical debt considerations.
* Provide subject matter expertise to the support team as they handle customer escalations, this could be from initial triage on accounts through to engineering root-cause analysis, fix validation, and customer-facing resolution.

jobs.description:
**About Bureau**

Bureau is a unified risk decisioning platform for Compliance, Fraud, and Transaction risks. Our platform is a single decision-making engine, powered by a 1 billion+ identity knowledge graph. Over 150 Banks, fintechs, retailers, and digital platforms use Bureau to verify identities faster and stop fraud earlier globally.

Bureau has raised $50M+ from renowned Silicon Valley and global investors including Sorenson Capital and PayPal Ventures and is expanding rapidly from APAC to Americas, Europe, and beyond.

**Why Bureau?**

Bureau is building the infrastructure that makes digital identities and transactions safe and trustworthy for billions of people. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is real.

We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, build systems from scratch, and care deeply about turning strategy into execution. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won't be your place. If you want to shape how a scaling global company operates—keep reading.

**About the Role: Senior Product Manager - Credit Risk**

You'll own Bureau's credit product line: the signals, scores and decisioning tools lenders use to approve, price and monitor borrowers.

This is a builder's seat. You've shipped credit products from the lender's side; now you'll turn that judgment into products hundreds of lenders use.

What you ship will shape how millions of people in India and beyond get access to credit.

**What you’ll be doing**

* **Own the credit signals roadmap.**
  Pick the next signals to build, from alternative data and behavioural patterns to fraud indicators that predict credit risk.
* **Go deep with lenders.**
  Learn how banks, NBFCs and fintechs underwrite and collect, and turn their pain into product.
* **Build across the credit lifecycle.**
  Onboarding, underwriting, limits, early warnings and collections.
* **Partner with data science.**
  Define what a great signal looks like and take models from experiment to production.
* **Ship, scale and prove impact.**
  Launch API-first products and track approval rates, delinquency and fraud loss.
* **Win with GTM and compliance.**
  Help sales pitch and price credit deals, and keep products aligned with RBI and data protection rules.

**What You’ll Bring**

**Must have**

* **5–8 years in product**
  , at PM or Senior PM level, owning products end to end.
* **Consumer-side credit experience**
  at a lender, NBFC, credit fintech or BNPL player, building and scaling products in India or globally.
* **Hands-on with signals:**
  bureau data, alternative data, risk scores or fraud indicators used to make better decisions.
* **Data fluency.**
  You can question a Gini or KS number and pull your own insights with SQL.
* **Clear communication**
  with a CRO, an engineer and a salesperson alike.

**Good to have**

* You've built or productised a credit score, risk model or decisioning engine.
* You've worked with India's credit stack: bureaus, Account Aggregator, UPI or GST data.
* You've sold data or risk tools to lenders on the B2B side.

Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.
  
  
From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners - including banks, networks, regulators - we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech
  
  
Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation - powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.
  
  
Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.
  
  
Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme - and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.
  
  
We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions - including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI) - along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.
  
  
But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen - you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle - if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People > Pedigree - we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles - this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy & Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors, you’ll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.
  
  
**The Role:**
As a PM2, you will independently own a product area or platform charter end-to-end — from strategy and roadmap to execution and business impact. You will operate with significant autonomy and drive initiatives across customer experience, platform scalability, automation, growth, and monetization. You will be expected to think beyond features and solve for systems, operational leverage, and long-term platform evolution.
  
  
**What you’ll do?**

* Build Customer Empathy - Regularly engage with customers, internal stakeholders, and ecosystem partners to deeply understand pain points, workflows, and unmet needs through both qualitative and quantitative insights.
* Drive Product Strategy - Define long-term product vision and quarterly roadmap aligned with business goals, customer outcomes, and platform scalability.
* Build Scalable Products - Collaborate with engineering, design, analytics, and operations teams to build reliable, scalable, and high-impact products.
* Lead Product Execution - Write high-quality product specifications, prioritize effectively, manage tradeoffs, and ensure timely execution across releases

**About The Team**
Product Management in Meesho closely resembles our rocketship growth. Because we obsess over understanding customer behaviour, we’ve been able to carve out an e-commerce niche in Tier 2/3/4 towns in Bharat. Our business growth is testimony to a singular focus on how we think of ‘product’ for our unique customers - ones that have barely shopped online, but are now able to because of Meesho.
  
  
Fun fact: Nearly 7% of India’s households shop with us. 😉
  
  
We are driven by a ‘user-first’ mindset. We have a strong bias for action. Above all, our team is driven by impact, not features. We drive ‘problem discovery’ & delivery - not only obsess over “what to build”, but execute with rigour to create impact.
  
  
But there’s more – we love to have fun as much as we love to work hard. From movie buffs to sportspersons, we have a super cool team. So, if a game of badminton after a day of brainstorming at work sounds like something you would love to do, then join us!
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Product Manager I who is passionate about solving high-impact problems in a fast-paced start-up environment with a high degree of autonomy. This is inherently a cross-functional leadership role where you will work closely with teams such as software engineering, UX design, category management, marketing, operations, finance, etc. to bring a new product to life.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Analysis, customer interviews, user research, competition analysis and other qualitative/quantitative techniques.
* Problem Identification & Prioritization: Adopt a structured approach to identify what problems need to be solved and break them down into smaller chunks. Prioritize what problems need to be solved now vs. later.

Harness the creativity of not just yourself but of other teams such as design, engineering., business, etc Be willing to experiment with multiple solution ideas and test them using MVPs, prototypes, etc.

Axi is a leading global provider of margin and deliverable Foreign Exchange, Contracts for Difference (CFDs), and Financial Spread betting. **About the job**

In this role, you will guide hardware onboarding across high-density AI clusters powering Gemini on GGC using Dell XE9780 servers with NVIDIA HGX, core enterprise and retail fleets using Dell XR8K / XR11, Dell PowerEdge R670 compute nodes, and Supermicro (SMC) platforms and tactical edge form factors. You will bridge the gap between physical server silicon, host OS environments, out-of-band management fabrics, and distributed cloud control planes and architect bare-metal turnup, firmware ingestion and attestation pipelines, enterprise storage encryption abstractions and pre-boot platform security controls.Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. This is a product role, not a project role. The Senior Product Owner owns the vision, the backlog and the outcomes — deciding what gets built and why, in what order, and being accountable for whether it actually improved anything. Success is measured in adoption, effort saved and experience improved, not in tickets closed or features shipped.

The role sits between three constituencies that rarely agree: employees who want their devices to just work, Security who want them locked down, and Finance who want them cheaper. Turning that tension into a prioritised, defensible backlog is the core of the job.

* Translate the EUC strategy and architecture direction into a sequenced, deliverable product backlog.
* Own the business case and benefits realisation for product investment; be accountable for the value claimed, not just the spend approved.
* Own, refine and prioritise the product backlog as the single source of truth for the squad; make prioritisation calls transparently and defend them.
* Write clear user stories and acceptance criteria that engineers can build from and testers can verify — specific about the outcome, not prescriptive about the solution.
* Lead sprint planning, refinement, review and retrospective alongside the Scrum Master; accept or reject work against acceptance criteria.

* Own the release and change approach for user-visible change, including pilot rings, communications and rollback triggers.
* Be the voice of the employee in every prioritisation conversation, and hold the evidence to back it: research, telemetry, ticket analysis and direct observation.
* Run continuous discovery — user interviews, shadowing in the field and on the shop floor, surveys, usability testing — with the populations who are least like head office.
* Convert digital experience (DEX) telemetry and service desk data into prioritised, root-cause-addressing backlog items; treat every recurring ticket category as a product defect until proven otherwise.
* Own adoption: define what good adoption looks like before launch, measure it after, and act when it does not materialise.
* Own the product for the mobile estate: enrolment and provisioning experience, BYOD vs. corporate-owned models, app catalogue and distribution, and the employee-facing side of mobile security policy.
* Own the BYOD proposition end to end — the privacy commitment, the employee terms, the enrolment journey and the trust that makes people willing to participate.

**Job Requirements**
Job Description
  
  
The Product Owner is responsible for defining, prioritizing, and delivering medical product capabilities that meet customer and market needs. Working with one or more Agile development teams, the Product Owner owns the product backlog, translates business requirements into product features, and ensures high-quality delivery throughout the product lifecycle. The role collaborates closely with customers, product management, engineering, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver innovative, interoperable, and compliant healthcare solutions.
  
  
Internal Stakeholders
  
  
Product Line Manager, Product Manager, Project Manager, Quality Manager, Development Team (e.g. Scrum Master, System Analyst, Architect, Developers, Testers), Usability Engineer, other stakeholders (e.g. Business Units), SCM (Enabling) & Customer Service teams, Technical Writers, etc.
  
  
External Stakeholders
  
  
Radiologists, Radiology Technicians, Hospital Administrators, IT Administrators etc.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's/Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, MCA, or equivalent.

**Experience**

* 12-15 years of experience in healthcare software, medical devices, or healthcare IT.
* Proven experience as a Product Owner, System Analyst, Technical Lead, or similar role in Agile product development.

Desired Knowledge & Experience
  
  

* Strong understanding of healthcare IT, radiology, and clinical workflows.
* Experience with HIS, RIS, PACS, EMR/EHR, and medical reporting solutions.
* Knowledge of healthcare interoperability standards: HL7, FHIR, DICOM, and IHE.
* Familiarity with healthcare integrations and interface platforms .
* Knowledge of SQL Server and/or PostgreSQL.
* Experience in requirements engineering, Agile (Scrum/SAFe), SDLC, and Product Lifecycle Management.
* Understanding of medical device regulations (FDA 21 CFR Part 820, MDR, ISO 13485).
* Previous experience in software development is preferred.
* Knowledge of Reporting domain is an advantage.

Core Competencies
  
  

* Customer-focused with strong product ownership.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and collaboration skills.
* Self-driven, results-oriented, and proactive.
* Ability to prioritize effectively and influence cross-functional teams.
* Comfortable working in global, Agile, and cross-functional environments.

**Work Experience**
Strong understanding of healthcare IT, radiology, and clinical workflows.
  
  

* Experience with HIS, RIS, PACS, EMR/EHR, and medical reporting solutions.
* Knowledge of healthcare interoperability standards: HL7, FHIR, DICOM, and IHE.
* Familiarity with healthcare integrations and interface platforms .
* Knowledge of SQL Server and/or PostgreSQL.
* Experience in requirements engineering, Agile (Scrum/SAFe), SDLC, and Product Lifecycle Management.
* Understanding of medical device regulations (FDA 21 CFR Part 820, MDR, ISO 13485).
* Previous experience in software development is preferred.
* Knowledge of Reporting domain is an advantage.

jobs.title: Fund Accounting and Administration Product Owner - Insurance Accounting, Vice President
jobs.description:
**Who We Are Looking For**
We are seeking a
**senior business Product Owner**
for the Insurance Accounting product within State Street’s Fund Accounting and Administration platform. This role represents accounting, operational, regulatory, and client needs and serves as a senior business authority across complex functional areas and strategic initiatives.
  
  
This is
**not a technical product owner role**
. While the position partners closely with technology and development teams, accountability is focused on
**business requirements, accounting logic, client outcomes, regulatory compliance, product strategy and prioritization**
, rather than system architecture or technical solution design.
  
  
**Why this role is important to us**
The Vice President, Product Owner plays a critical role in ensuring that product capabilities and enhancements accurately reflect insurance and investment accounting requirements and deliver meaningful value to clients. By acting as the voice of the business, this role ensures solutions are fit for purpose, compliant, and aligned with product strategy, while enabling efficient and effective delivery through agile development teams. The role also drives alignment across business and technology stakeholders, and supports investment decisions for complex, multi-year initiatives.
  
  
**What You Will Be Responsible For**
As the Vice President, Product Owner, you will act as a
**senior business lead and subject matter expert**
for the Insurance Accounting product and related strategic initiatives. Responsibilities include:
  
  

* Serving as one of the primary business authorities for insurance accounting functionality and related reporting
* Communicating product direction and measurable business outcomes for assigned product capabilities
* Leading complex product initiatives and enhancements that span multiple business processes, client segments, or delivery teams
* Engaging clients and internal stakeholders to understand needs, priorities, and impacts
* Leading business analysis and functional design efforts; creating clear business design documents and requirements
* Defining accounting ledger entries, multi-cost basis behavior, and accounting outcomes for enhancements
* Establishing needs for reporting solutions and ensuring alignment with accounting, regulatory, and client requirements
* Translating business and accounting requirements into well-defined epics, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria
* Providing business use cases and functional testing scenarios
* Providing senior-level oversight of testing strategy and validating accounting accuracy, control effectiveness, and business outcomes
* Partnering with product management, development, operations, client service, and other stakeholders to manage dependencies, resolve issues, and maintain an actionable backlog
* Assisting with product roadmaps and longer-term functional direction, including recommendations for modernization
* Overseeing delivery of enhancements through iterative planning, prioritizing business value and client impact
* Identifying cross-product and data dependencies and driving alignment across accounting, reporting, operational, and client-facing capabilities
* Creating and maintaining user documentation
* Delivering training sessions, and product demonstrations for internal teams and current or prospective clients
* Supporting software maintenance and client service teams with business-level troubleshootingAssisting onboarding teams and clients with conversions and implementations, as needed

**What We Value**
The following skills and attributes will help you succeed in this role:
  
  

* Strategic product leadership and the ability to translate business objectives into clear product direction and priorities
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills, including the ability to make informed decisions in complex or ambiguous situations
* Deep analytical and research capabilities
* Sound accounting judgment and attention to financial details
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and initiatives simultaneously
* Clear and effective communication with a wide range of stakeholders
* Strong presentation and written communication skills
* Ability to build alignment and drive accountability across complex initiatives
* Excellent time management and organizational skills
* Proficiency with Microsoft tools (Copilot, Teams, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.)

**Education & Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in accounting or a related field; advanced degree, CPA, CFA, or relevant product experience is preferred.
* 12+ years of experience as a business Product Owner, product leader, or senior end user of insurance, fund accounting, or financial software
* OR 12+ years of experience as a senior business analyst, business Product Owner, or product leader supporting financial or accounting platforms
* Demonstrated experience leading complex product initiatives
* Strong experience with insurance accounting and/or investment accounting, including complex asset classes (e.g., fixed income, derivatives, mortgage loans, alternative investments)
* Knowledge of inbound and outbound data flows across the investment lifecycle (e.g., trade processing, cash, market data)
* Experience leading within an agile software development environment as a business Product Owner, product leader, or senior business analyst
* Significant experience working directly with clients and other stakeholders
* Experience with AI tools and applying them to improve product development, analysis, and day-to-day business processes

*This role does not require hands-on software development, system architecture design, or technical solution ownership.*
**Are you the right candidate? Yes!**
We truly believe in the power that comes from the diverse backgrounds and experiences our employees bring with them. Although each vacancy details what we are looking for, we don’t necessarily need you to fulfil all of them…

jobs.title: Oracle Incentive Compensation Product Owner
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

As the Oracle Incentive Compensation (OIC) Product Owner, you will drive the strategic implementation, optimization, and governance of our global Incentive compensation platforms. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, Sales Operations, Finance, and IT engineering teams, ensuring incentive compensation plans, crediting logic, and payout calculations align with business strategy and operate seamlessly. By applying a data-driven approach and scalable product management principles, you will enhance accuracy and deliver high-impact automated compensation solutions.The role will involve driving the successful delivery of the solution while considering the end-to-end view.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Product Vision & Roadmap:**
  Define and maintain the product roadmap for Oracle Incentive Compensation for new acquisitions, aligning with global sales strategy.
* **Backlog Management:**
  Author detailed user stories, define acceptance criteria, and prioritize the sprint backlog to ensure the engineering team delivers maximum business value.
* **Requirements Gathering and Analysis:**
  Collaborate with stakeholders, customers, and internal teams to gather requirements. Conduct research, stakeholder analysis, and user feedback analysis to inform product decisions.
* **Stakeholder Alignment:**
  Collaborate with Sales Operations, Finance, and HR to translate complex compensation plans and quota models into functional system requirements.
* **Process Optimization:**
  Identify opportunities to automate manual processes.
* **UAT & Quality Assurance:**
  Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for new releases, ensuring accurate incentive calculations.
* **Data and Process Governance:**
  Ensure seamless data flow between OIC (actuals/payouts) and upstream and downstream systems.
* **Data Driven / Prioritization:**
  Bring a data-driven approach to the product and provide insights into how the product is performing and capturing business value. Using those data insights, prioritize effectively to drive the product forward using data insights to make decisions

**Basic Requirements**

* **Experience:**
  6+ years of experience in Product Ownership or Business Analysis, specifically within the
  **Oracle Incentive compensation/Sales planning**
  suite.
* **Core Expertise:**
  Deep functional knowledge of
  **Oracle Incentive Compensation**
  (Rules engine, Plan components, Credits, and Payouts) and Sales planning process
* **Agile Mastery:**
  Proven track record working in an Agile/Scrum environment, managing ceremonies and using tools like Jira. Leading cross-functional teams and curating product backlogs.
* **Analytical Mindset:**
  Ability to troubleshoot complex logic within compensation formulas and SQL-based data sets.
* **Domain Knowledge:**
  Deep comprehension of product features, industry standards, and security protocols.
* **Solving:**
  Skill in maneuvering through ambiguous scenarios and resolving operational roadblocks independently.
* **Proactive Execution:**
  High initiative with a focus on achieving strategic objectives autonomously.
* **Analytical Aptitude:**
  Exceptional capacity for synthesizing intricate requirements into actionable functional specs.
* **Communication & Leadership:**
  Superior written and verbal skills, proficient at driving consensus across diverse stakeholder groups.
